title: data for diagram.archive
description: Rev 2 (M2): the owner's explicit confirmation that a task may lose its diagram. Owner only, from an owner UI credential (contract 3.5). Detaches the attached diagram (dg-N) from the task: a side-log line diagram.archive is written, the pointer leaves tasks[id].diagram, and nothing is destroyed (every revision blob and side line stays; the diagram is read through GET /api/v1/diagram/:task?diagram=dg-N[&rev=R] and its history through .../history?diagram=dg-N). confirm must equal '<task id>@r<current rev>' (400 confirm_mismatch), so the act names this diagram at this revision. Only after it may task.delete remove the task (task.delete on a task with an attached diagram is 409 diagram_attached for every actor). A re-created task id never inherits an archived diagram: diagram.create makes a new dg-N at the sent rev. Rev 3 (contract 3.7): owner-only, needs an owner device (TOTP step-up once per device); otherwise 403 owner_device_required.
